review_candidates.title: Network and Infrastructure Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: About the role Join LDK as a Network and Infrastructure Specialist, where you'll play a key role in maintaining and enhancing the technology that supports our residents and teams. You'll be responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing network and IT infrastructure, providing day-to-day technical support, leading infrastructure projects, and managing ICT assets across our villages. Role responsibilities Maintain, monitor, and optimise network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN
eligibility_evidence: On-site facilities include a gym, art centre, chapel, dance room, theatre, library, several hospitality outlets, village shed, barber shop, hairdresser, medical consultation room, grocer, purpose designed meeting spaces and a dog park.
Experience working with Cisco technologies including Meraki, as well as virtualised and hybrid infrastructure environments.
Benefits Competitive salary package Free on-site parking Flexible working arrangements Purchased leave options, giving you the flexibility to take extra time off when you need it.

Salary packaging with novated leasing options Rewards and retail discounts program Free daily coffee/tea/standard beverage for all staff Continuous professional development and promotion opportunities Excellent company culture underpinned by Love, Decency and Kindness (LDK) Beautiful workplace envir
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Ensure compliance with security and data protection requirements while supporting users and promoting technology best practices across the organisation. Qualifications, Experience and Skills ITIL Foundation certification required, with CCNA (Switching & Routing/Wireless), CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Azure, or relevant IT qualifications highly regarded. Minimum 5 years' hands-on experience in network and infrastructure management, including network security, firewalls, VPNs, server administration, and cloud environments.
